entry.title: Seminar and round table with Prof. Selina Wriessnegger

link.title: Seminar and round table with Prof. Selina Wriessnegger

entry.content:
The WavesLab is excited to announce that Prof. Selina Wriessnegger from the Technical University of Graz (Austria) will be Visiting Professor from November 23r to December 4th.

On November, 26th she will give a seminar on Passive Brain-Computer Interfaces in EEG-based neuroadaptive systems. Following, a round table will take place with other two guests, Dr. Luisa Cacciante (speech therapist from IRCCS San Camillo of Venice) and Prof. Pietro Aricò (Associate Professor in Bioengineering at Sapienza University).

The event is free and open to everyone, just upon registration (a registration form will be soon available).
entry.summary: Seminar and round table with Prof. Selina Wriessnegger (TU Graz) at Palazzo Berlam in Trieste on November, 26th. Don't miss it out!

entry.title: Prof. Selina Wriessnegger Visiting Professor at the WavesLab

link.title: Prof. Selina Wriessnegger Visiting Professor at the WavesLab

entry.content:
The WavesLab will welcome Prof. Selina Wriessnegger from the Technical University of Graz (Austria) as a Visiting Professor from November 23rd to December 4th.

During her stay, she will held two classes to our students of Computational Neuroscience in the Data Science & Artificial Intelligence (DSAI) Master of Science Degree. Classes will cover the most important principles for designing an effective Brain-Computer Interface, and different types of BCIs with examples (active, reactive and passive).

On November, 26th she will also give a seminar on Passive Brain-Computer Interfaces in EEG-based neuroadaptive systems and take part in the following round table (see related news).

The WavesLab wants to thank the Department of Mathematics, Informatics, and Geosciences and the University of Trieste for supporting this Visiting Professor opportunity.
entry.summary: Prof. Selina Wriessnegger (TU Graz) will visit Units from Nov.23rd to Dec.4th

entry.title: Welcoming Visiting Student Yusuf Üveyik!
entry.content:
The WavesLab warmly welcomes Yusuf Üveyik, a BSc student from Marmara University of Istanbul (Turkey)!

Yusuf will be joining us as a visiting student from July 14th to September 30th. We are thrilled to have him on board for the summer!

entry.title: WavesLab at Trieste Next 2026!
entry.content:
The WavesLab is excited to participate in Trieste Next 2026 from September 25th to 27th.

Come visit us to learn more about our ongoing research in biosignal preprocessing, EEG/ECG modeling, and neural interfaces!
entry.summary: The WavesLab will be present at Trieste Next 2026 in September, 25-27. Don't miss it out!
